name: OIDC login and sessions
story: As a user I sign in without a project-specific password store.
behavior: Authorization code + PKCE via backend; callback validates state/nonce/issuer/audience; set opaque HttpOnly session; GET /v1/me returns identity; logout revokes session.
edges: Expired code, replay, disabled identity provider, clock skew ≤60s; safe return path only.
security: Secure SameSite=Lax cookie; CSRF header on mutations; no tokens in browser storage.
acceptance: Invalid/replayed callbacks rejected; logout invalidates next API request.

name: Workspaces and membership
story: As an owner I create a workspace and manage known users.
behavior: Create workspace and owner membership atomically; list only memberships; add existing user by exact verified email; update role/remove membership; exactly one or more owners.
edges: Last-owner removal/demotion 409; unknown email generic 404; workspace deletion asynchronously purges data.
security: Owner manages membership; no public user directory; all mutations audited; active requests recheck revocation.
acceptance: Two-tenant tests cannot enumerate or read foreign IDs; last owner invariant holds under race.

name: Knowledge bases
story: As an editor I organize documents into named collections.
behavior: Create/list KBs; admin deletes KB asynchronously; name 1–120 characters; all members read workspace KBs.
edges: Duplicate names 409; deletion cancels jobs and tombstones sources immediately.
security: Editor writes; viewer reads; tenant composite foreign keys.
acceptance: Deletion makes every child unavailable before 202 is returned.

name: Secure document upload
story: As an editor I upload supported knowledge with understandable validation.
behavior: POST multipart upload accepts one file ≤20 MiB, PDF/DOCX/MD/HTML/TXT/CSV/JSON; API stores opaque object, creates revision and queued job, returns 202.
edges: Zero bytes, bad MIME/magic, encrypted PDF, zip bomb, malformed encoding fail with stable reason; identical file to same document/config returns existing revision.
security: No path interpolation or remote URL ingestion; parser network disabled; quota 1 GiB/workspace.
acceptance: Rejected files never searchable; accepted upload has revision/job IDs; 20 MiB+1 rejected 413.

name: Durable ingestion and revisions
story: As an editor I see progress and retry a failed source safely.
behavior: Poll job and document; validate→parse→normalize→chunk→dense+sparse embed→Qdrant delivery/verification→PostgreSQL pointer publication. Reprocess freezes profiles; previous active revision remains until complete manifest verification.
edges: Crash after any stage reclaims lease; three attempts then dead; no partial publication; OCR-needed is explicit unsupported failure in core.
security: Current membership/write policy checked at enqueue; worker uses tenant scope and fencing; tombstone always wins.
acceptance: Kill/retry each ingestion and outbox boundary; staging points remain invisible; one active revision has exact verified point IDs/count/hashes.

name: Conversations and history
story: As a member I revisit my own discussions.
behavior: Create/list/get/delete own conversations; append immutable user message with a run; paginated messages by sequence; display partial/failed answers distinctly.
edges: One active run per conversation; conflict 409; deleting cancels run and removes history; same idempotency key cannot duplicate user message.
security: Conversation owner only, including workspace admins; metadata-only aggregate usage permitted.
acceptance: Concurrent submissions produce one active run; deleted history disappears and cannot be replayed.

name: Grounded streaming answers
story: As a user I receive a sourced answer and know when evidence is insufficient.
behavior: Bounded LangGraph answer workflow; create run then authenticated SSE from committed PostgreSQL events. Final Answer has evidence refs and answered/abstained status; no evidence abstains without LLM; ambiguous issued attempts never replay automatically.
edges: Reconnect, cancel, refusal, malformed JSON, provider failure after text; draft display is unverified until completed.
security: Authorized published sources only; citations checked server-side; no untrusted HTML.
acceptance: Final citations resolve to supplied visible chunks; no failed draft is marked completed; absent evidence abstains.

name: Evidence inspector
story: As a user I verify a claim in its original context.
behavior: Click citation opens chunk text with document/revision/page/heading; authorized original download is proxied as attachment.
edges: Old revision stays inspectable while document exists; deleted source shows unavailable and redacts quoted content.
security: Recheck membership/tombstone on every read; no public or long-lived object URLs.
acceptance: Every citation links to exact stored normalized passage and correct page metadata.

name: Providers and model selection
story: As a user I can choose a permitted paid or local model.
behavior: Catalog lists logical keys, capability/availability and privacy; auto or explicit key per run; core adapters OpenAI and Ollama; Anthropic/Google conformance mandatory before claiming support.
edges: Missing credential disables candidate; unsupported schema or context rejects request; explicit selection never silently switches model.
security: Endpoint URLs/admin keys cannot come from prompt or user body; local-only workspace blocks all paid calls.
acceptance: Same fixtures validate both core adapters; local-only spy records zero external calls.

name: Routing, budgets and usage
story: As an owner I control spend and inspect honest accounting.
behavior: Deterministic capability/privacy/budget filters; reserve worst-case cost in DB; settle each attempt; daily/monthly limits; GET usage groups by day/model.
edges: Concurrent requests cannot over-reserve; unknown provider usage remains estimated; failure is not free; denied budget 429.
security: Owner/admin sees workspace aggregates; members own usage; no full prompts in reports.
acceptance: Race test stays within reservations; all retry/fallback costs counted; request cap $0.05.

name: Retrieval controls
story: As an editor I compare retrieval choices without changing tenant policy.
behavior: Owner/admin selects dense/hybrid/hybrid_rerank profile and top_k1–8. Qdrant dense+sparse branches use server-authorized revision filters; PostgreSQL hydrates/rechecks candidate text; scope above4096 revisions returns422.
edges: Empty KB, filters removing all candidates, reranker timeout, invalid profile; response records degradation.
security: Server-enforced scope; query rewrites cannot add KBs or tenant IDs.
acceptance: Identical frozen collection/corpus/config across variants; every branch excludes unauthorized/staging points; sparse IDF scope explicitly reported.

name: Document comparison and brief tool
story: As an engineer I compare two revisions and save a reviewed evidence brief.
behavior: LangGraph compares exactly two authorized revisions with bounded reads. Separate brief graph pauses for explicit payload-bound approval; REST decision returns approved/running until unique save succeeds.
edges: Missing revision, conflicting statements, approval expiry, duplicate approval, revoked role, step exhaustion.
security: Two authorized revisions; no arbitrary tools; editor approval rechecked at execution; viewer cannot save.
acceptance: Restart at interrupt and duplicate approval produce one brief; changed hash/revoked sources/expired approval prevent save; completed answer stream never reopens.

name: Conversation memory
story: As a user I ask a follow-up within a bounded private history.
behavior: Last six completed turns prioritized with a 2048-token history budget; optional summary of older turns with provenance; no global personal memory.
edges: Budget overflow drops oldest; deleted/tombstoned citations invalidate summary; summary failure falls back to recent turns.
security: Summary is untrusted context, creator-scoped, deleted with conversation.
acceptance: Pronoun follow-up preserves intent; planted historical instruction cannot change tool permissions.

name: Feedback and quality review
story: As a user I flag an unhelpful or unsupported answer.
behavior: Upsert own message feedback vote ±1 and optional reason ≤1000 chars; no automatic training; admin sees aggregate counts.
edges: Feedback on nonfinal/nonowned message 404/409; repeats replace vote.
security: No other user conversation exposed; opt-in export only with sanitized evidence.
acceptance: Vote round trips and deletion removes it; feedback alone cannot alter prompts/models.

name: Evaluation dashboard
story: As a maintainer I review versioned experiments before promoting a change.
behavior: Offline runner posts signed/admin-authenticated aggregate report and case metadata; list/get eval runs; metrics, dataset/config hash and hardware visible.
edges: Missing samples, timeouts and failed runs counted; no benchmark claim from smoke data.
security: Owner/admin; sanitized public corpus only for demo; artifact references cannot be external fetch instructions.
acceptance: Four retrieval variants and paid/local comparison reports reproducible from frozen manifests.

name: Administration and health
story: As an operator I identify unhealthy dependencies without leaking secrets.
behavior: Settings manage privacy/budgets/retrieval; process-only liveness; readiness checks PostgreSQL schema, Qdrant profile/index and checkpoint capability; admin health shows dependency/queue status.
edges: Provider unavailable means degraded health, not API liveness failure; schema mismatch blocks readiness.
security: Public health contains no versions, credentials or tenant names; config changes audit actor/diff.
acceptance: Provider outage leaves source browsing operational; missing DB returns readiness 503.

name: Deletion, retention and recovery
story: As an owner I remove data and understand backup retention.
behavior: Tombstone first fences reads/jobs; purge PG content, objects, every Qdrant generation and workflow checkpoints within24h. Retain conversations90d/backups30d; restore applies deletion log and verifies/rebuilds indexes before admission.
edges: In-flight generation, offline worker, object delete failure, backup restore after deletion.
security: Audit contains IDs not content; document deletion invalidates cached evidence/summary; restored tenants remain offline until tombstones reconciled.
acceptance: Concurrent delete test prevents further content replay; restore exercise meets stated RPO/RTO.

name: Accessible frontend
story: As a keyboard or mobile user I can complete the main workflow.
behavior: Workspace/KB/chat/source/settings/usage/eval screens; adaptive panels; keyboard focus, screen-reader status, reduced-motion; no developer internals on main flow.
edges: Offline, interrupted stream, 401/403, pending ingestion and empty workspace have actionable states.
security: Escape all model output; Markdown links allow only safe schemes; no external image loads.
acceptance: Playwright upload→answer→citation→feedback passes desktop/mobile; automated a11y has no serious/critical findings.
